tasks.title: Create a shared microscopy icon system
tasks.scope: Move thin-stroke SVG construction into a dependency-free UI helper. Define symbols that communicate Micronaut's real concepts—project description, study, experimental design, microscopy, naming, and study overview—rather than generic office or palette metaphors.
tasks.verification: Every icon is decorative and retains an accessible labelled parent control; the single-file build accepts the new import graph.

tasks.title: Apply contextual icons to shell and entry choices
tasks.scope: Use the shared symbols for the logo, step navigation, Home entry cards, and onboarding project-stage choices. Remove their emoji icons without changing navigation or onboarding behavior.
tasks.verification: Serve the built artifact and exercise Home, Project, Microscopy, and the onboarding gate. Confirm the logo is a microscope, no emoji entry-card glyph remains, route controls retain accessible names, and the test suite/build pass.
